Lucas FM 0.2 for M-VAVE FM-1

Open lucas-fm-0.2.fwsc with Open .fwsc in https://joakimeriksson.github.io/fm1-emu/ and choose 240 MHz. Ten public imported sounds, factory instruments/kits and an editable starter beat are already present. Press PLAY for drums; LFO opens loops.

ALGORITHM selects the part. PRESETS browses sounds. EDIT opens Sound; SELECT there chooses the engine. HOME always returns. FX opens effects, SELECT chooses an effect, EDIT toggles bypass, and the four knobs follow the screen labels.

On the development Mac: Launch Lucas FM.command uses your ignored private 0.2 package when available, including your personal drum kit. Personal audio is not in this public bundle.

Native emulator: fm1-live --fwsc lucas-fm-0.2.fwsc --midi none --mhz 240

lucas-fm-0.2-update.fwsc is the firmware-only package. The physical updater preserves samples and does not install the preloaded collection. Transfer the .lucaspack separately with the editor on hardware. No physical device has been flashed or tested.

GUIDE.md explains controls. 0.2.md records current validation and limits. VALIDATION.md is historical 0.1 evidence. DEVELOPMENT.md explains builds. source-commit.txt and SHA256SUMS identify this firmware.

Limits: four concurrent imports, eight shared pitched voices, offline pitch/tempo preparation. Heavy VOICE presets can pause shared effects; 100 MHz full workloads overload. Full upstream CI retains known static instruction-budget failures; see the report.

Complete corresponding source and licenses:
